name: godot-mcp
description: Godot MCP server - Godot 4.x engine control via TCP bridge, STL/GLB/OBJ import, GPU particles, animation, HTML5 export, itch.io/Steam shipping, AI game builder through MCP tools and REST API

tools.name: get_skill_api
tools.description: Get the content of a specific skill.

tools.name: api_status
tools.description: Server status including Godot engine and TCP bridge info.

tools.name: api_capabilities
tools.description: Runtime feature gating for the webapp (fleet capability introspection standard).

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List uploaded files and output files.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a file from uploads or outputs.

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.description: Execute a Godot MCP tool via REST bridge.

tools.name: start_bridge_endpoint
tools.description: Locate Godot and launch it headless with the MCP bridge addon.

tools.name: find_godot_endpoint
tools.description: Check if Godot is installed and where.

tools.name: llm_detect
tools.description: Detect GPU, VRAM, Ollama, and installed models.

tools.name: llm_recommend
tools.description: Recommend the best LLM model based on detected hardware + installed models.

tools.name: capture_viewport_endpoint
tools.description: Capture Godot viewport as PNG. Bridge must be connected.

tools.name: simulate_input_endpoint
tools.description: Simulate keyboard input in the Godot engine. Bridge must be connected.

tools.name: profile_history_endpoint
tools.description: Read profiling history with spike detection.

tools.name: read_node_endpoint
tools.description: Read a single node's properties by name or path.

tools.name: state_digest_endpoint
tools.description: Read structured game state (watch group or named nodes).

tools.name: validate_meshes_endpoint
tools.description: Validate all meshes for geometric corruption.

tools.name: procedural_texture_endpoint
tools.description: Generate a procedural texture (gradient, noise, checker, solid).

tools.name: live_viewport
tools.description: Return the latest viewport capture as a PNG image.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List available community plugins and their install status.

tools.name: install_plugin
tools.description: Install a community plugin from the registry.

tools.name: mobile_help
tools.description: Full protocol reference for iOS mobile clients - machine-readable JSON.

tools.name: mobile_command_fallback
tools.description: REST fallback for iOS mobile commands (stateless, no subscriptions).

tools.name: install_addon
tools.description: Install the Godot MCP bridge addon into a target project.
